errors.text_span: 刻度类型为线性且数值范围从1到4，间隔为1
errors.evidence: The x-axis is categorical, not numerical. Describing it as having a linear scale, a numerical range from 1 to 4, and an interval of 1 is incorrect as these features do not exist.

The description assigns the data values of the TiPLMT model (orange bars) to the GPT model (green bars). The correct values for GPT are 87.34%, 73.09%, 62.02%, and 54.89%. The description also incorrectly states the trend for GPT as rising ('升至') to the first value.

The description incorrectly assigns data values from the GPT model to the TiPLMT model. The correct values for TiPLMT are 91.65%, 76.34%, 64.83%, and 57.63%. The description incorrectly lists the first, third, and fourth values as 87.34%, 62.02%, and 54.89%, which belong to GPT.
